summary: Sunday crypto edition. BTC $60,047 just 3.4% above 52W low ($58,076). ETH $1,572, 4.3% above annual floor. All major cryptos red. Iran tensions reignite. Regime: ERO 44.2%, crisis 26.9%, score 24.6. Monday: GOOGL joins Dow, Russell Reconstitution $334B, NKE earnings. NFP Friday Jul 3 on half-day session.

risks.label: BTC 3.4% above 52-week low — capitulation zone
risks.detail: Bitcoin at $60,047, just $1,971 above annual floor at $58,076. 52.4% below ATH ($126,198). Below 50d avg by 14.5%, below 200d avg by 21.0%. A break below $58K triggers cascading liquidations targeting $54K.

risks.label: US-Iran ceasefire violations — attacks escalating
risks.detail: IBD: 'Market at Tipping Point as U.S.-Iran Attacks Escalate.' Trump accuses Iran of violating ceasefire. Any escalation = oil spikes, crypto drops in sympathy. Gold responding with +1.20% safe haven bid to $4,096.

risks.label: SPY below 50-day EMA — tech rotation accelerating
risks.detail: SPY $728.99 below EMA50 ($730.00). QQQ -1.38% Friday. SMH (semis) -4.4% on the week. ON Semi -23.7%. Rotation from tech to healthcare/small-caps.

risks.label: 7 of 9 major cryptos within 5% of annual lows
risks.detail: BTC +3.4%, ETH +4.3%, XRP +3.7%, ADA +4.3%, DOGE +2.5%, DOT +1.6%, LINK +3.7% above 52W lows. Clustering near floors precedes either coordinated flush or maximum-pessimism bottoming.

risks.label: Oil below $70 despite Iran tensions — demand destruction
risks.detail: WTI $69.23 (-3.74%), Brent $72.60 (-3.84%). Oil falling despite geopolitical risk = demand concerns dominating. Next support $65. Sub-$65 = recession indicator.

risks.label: Nikkei -4.15% crash — carry trade unwind risk
risks.detail: Nikkei 225 at 69,361 after Friday's crash. USD/JPY 161.69 near critical 160 level. Further yen strengthening triggers forced liquidation of carry positions with global spillover.

risks.label: NFP on half-day session — liquidity trap
risks.detail: Non-Farm Payrolls Friday July 3 on a half-day session before July 4. Thin liquidity amplifies moves. True repricing deferred to Monday July 7.

risks.label: FOMC Minutes Thursday — hawkish surprise risk
risks.detail: June meeting minutes release July 2. Hawkish tone = rate-sensitive sectors reprice lower. Market positioned for 1 cut in 2026.

events.label: Alphabet joins Dow Jones — replacing Verizon
events.detail: GOOGL replaces VZ effective Monday June 29. At ~$350/share, GOOGL carries 8x more Dow weight than VZ's $45. Six of 30 Dow components now mega-cap tech. DIA-tracking funds must rebalance.

events.label: Russell Reconstitution effective Monday
events.detail: $334B rebalance volume. IWM near 52-week high ($301.50). Mid-cap additions get tailwind, deletions face mechanical selling.

events.label: NKE + STZ Earnings Monday AMC
events.detail: Nike Q4 (implied move +/-8.5%, $60B mkt cap) — consumer spending bellwether. STZ Q1 (implied move +/-4.7%, $25B). Weak NKE = discretionary slowdown signal.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI Wednesday
events.detail: Factory health indicator. Sub-48 = industrial recession signal. Above 50 = expansion confirmed.

events.label: Non-Farm Payrolls Friday July 3
events.detail: High-impact jobs data on half-day session. July 4 weekend = thin liquidity. Oversized initial reaction with deferred repricing.

events.label: Healthcare XLV at 52-week high
events.detail: XLV surged +3.03% Friday to $160.34. Flight-to-quality trade accelerating. Late-cycle defensive rotation confirmed.

events.label: Consumer Confidence Tuesday
events.detail: Conference Board reading. Strong = validates consumer resilience. Weak = risk-off acceleration.

opportunities.label: XLV Healthcare — 52W high momentum play
opportunities.detail: +3.03% Friday, 52-week high $160.34. Late-cycle defensive play. RSI ~60. Entry $159.50-160.50, stop $156, TP1 $165, TP2 $170.

opportunities.label: BTC $58K support bounce — reactive swing
opportunities.detail: 52-week low at $58,076. If tested and held, bounce to $63K-$66K. Entry $58,500-$59,500, stop $56,800, TP1 $63K. R:R 1:2.5.

opportunities.label: IWM Russell 2000 — breakout above $301.50
opportunities.detail: Closed $299.83, $1.67 from 52W high. RSI 60.6, MACD bullish. Russell Reconstitution flows Monday.

opportunities.label: ETH DCA accumulation zone $1,500-$1,580
opportunities.detail: 4.3% above 52W low. ETH/BTC at multi-year lows. DCA tranches: $1,570, $1,510, $1,400. Hard stop $1,380. TP1 $1,750.

opportunities.label: Gold $4,096 — safe haven bid strengthening
opportunities.detail: GLD RSI 35.6 (oversold). +1.20% Friday on Iran escalation. Gold/oil ratio 59.2 signals quality over inflation.

regime_blips.label: ERO dominant at 44.2% — regime persistence
regime_blips.detail: Ensemble: ERO 44.2%, crisis 26.9%, neutral 22.2%, risk_on 6.7%. Score 24.6/100. 5d transition: ERO 29.6%, crisis 23.4% — roughly equal odds of improvement or deterioration.

regime_blips.label: Sector spread 4.9% — extreme rotation
regime_blips.detail: XLV +3.03% vs XLK -1.87% = 4.9pp spread Friday. S&P barely moved (-0.05%). Late-cycle defensiveness signal.

regime_blips.label: Gold/oil divergence — quality over inflation
regime_blips.detail: Gold +1.20% to $4,096 while WTI -3.74% to $69.23. Gold/oil ratio 59.2. Favors defensive yield plays over energy.

regime_blips.label: Crypto bear deepens — all 9 major assets red
regime_blips.detail: Not a single major crypto positive. DOT -3.65% worst. BTC -52.4% from ATH. Market at Phase 2/3 boundary (Fear/Capitulation).

regime_blips.label: SPY below 50 EMA, IWM near 52W high — bifurcated
regime_blips.detail: SPY below EMA50 while DIA and IWM above all EMAs. Large-cap tech is weak, small-cap breadth is healthy. Rotation story, not broad selloff.
